column1: # AIContext batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Terrain/path helpers are one-line delegations to TerrainGrid (hasPathToUnit, isAllLandTile, ...)
# so they reuse those names. The cached lists are: l=own immobile, p=own mobile, r=l+p (all own),
# m=visible enemies, n=visible enemies plus unowned, q=visible enemy mobile, d=visible enemies at
# one tile, e=the unassigned pool that claimUnits() drains. Player.a(Player) is isEnemyOf
# (this != other && different team), which fixes the polarity of that whole family.
# Three rows stay blank on purpose: the int field n has no call site to confirm its meaning, and
# s() is q()+m() where q is already a subset of m, so the intended semantics is unconfirmed.
